derived_projection.registry_inventory: One validated DeviceResolution.InventoryEntity JSON per registry_id/entry_id, sealed with registry membership. Full inventory includes types, bindings and nonexecutable other nodes.
derived_projection.variants: Per proven source occurrence/shape: schema_hash, availability Rule, dependencies[{entry_id,schema_hash}]. Unknown lifecycle or unresolved required type schema produces explicit unknown_reason with retained source evidence.
derived_projection.schema_hash: Use the exact canonical dispatch_manifest contract digest, factored into one shared function. Never invent or select a wire codec from declaration order.
derived_projection.evidence_ids: Canonical immutable source_ids; detailed source/locator and raw lifecycle evidence retained in registry entry extensions and source records.
derived_projection.source_occurrence_only: An explicit platform_api_version major.minor occurrence supports only that discrete version interval [major,minor]..[major,minor+1]. api_level major alone is insufficient to infer minor applicability. The review suggestion to widen an occurrence to an entire major would violate the user's new minor-version requirement and is not adopted.
derived_projection.index_ranges: Published since/removed attributes define inclusive introduced and exclusive removed. sdks gives separately evidenced platform/extension alternatives; retain container constraints via the containing type dependency. Unknown semantic syntax stays unknown.
derived_projection.TypeReference.resolved_binding_id: Resolve only a unique declared type identity in the same repository/revision/platform snapshot, with language/package/nesting/import evidence. Preserve source text and proof. Ambiguous/unresolved types remain unknown, never guessed across snapshots. Derived registry docs may add proof without rewriting immutable source declarations.
derived_projection.dependencies: Required argument, return, structured-field and containing-type schemas pinned by entry_id+schema_hash. Cycles allowed; unresolved required schema keeps the variant unknown. Intrinsic language types must be represented explicitly or declared intrinsic by a versioned type contract; no invented Java class or Binder wire layout.
